description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller, QuestionController, which manages CRUD operations for Question entities via HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller handling questions-related HTTP requests, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting questions.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question by ID.
